source_semantics: AusTraits v7 config/traits.yml is authoritative for numeric vs categorical type and standard unit.
record_identity: dataset_id + ASCII unit-separator + observation_id; rows are deduplicated at record_key x trait x value before species-state aggregation.

validity: all eligible nonmissing values parse as finite double
config units field must be nonempty
every eligible record unit is nonempty and exactly equals config units
numeric.species_state: median of deduplicated eligible record values

validity: every eligible record unit is null/empty
categorical.species_state: unique modal category across deduplicated eligible records

structural_candidate_rule: Only v0.2 structural PASS family x trait systems enter.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop AusTraits replication before memory effects.
